response.sql: SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(t.telescregistry) as telescope_count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.equipstatus != 'Maintenance' GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;
